name: patient-management-system
description: MediCore Patient Management System — React, NestJS, PostgreSQL

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm install
scripts.db:setup: npm run prisma:generate --prefix backend && npm run prisma:push --prefix backend && npm run prisma:seed --prefix backend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend"
